findings.title: Web server startup doesn't halt the process
findings.description: The envValidator logs an error when sensitive credentials are missing but doesn't call process.exit(1). The web server startup function returns early so the server doesn't start, but the bot continues running. This is correct behavior (Discord commands work without the web server). Not a bug, but could add a log line confirming 'Bot will continue without web server.'

findings.title: Lottery daily reset uses UTC midnight
findings.description: The daily ticket limit resets at midnight UTC, not the user's local midnight. A user in UTC+7 (Vietnam) experiences the reset at 7:00 AM local time. The prior daily-module refactor used timezone-aware resets; lottery should match. Consider using the same timezone logic or documenting the UTC reset behavior.
